body: Built in batch/ (core module, stdlib only) on the run-finished hook: a Manager (batch.New(client, store); Attach before Start; Dispatch, Progress, Cancel, RunFinished) with a Store interface and MemoryStore, keyed on job labels carrying the batch ID and job index. Needs a client with CapRunFinished. Semantics: Catch fires on the first failure even with AllowFailures; AllowFailures only stops the batch from cancelling its other jobs.
title: Batch: a group of jobs with Then, Catch and Finally workflows
